You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
[#7] AGENT: I'll verify your identity first, then help with those transfers. Great, Jamal. I can help with that. Let me find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview to confirm the right location. I'm not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you give me the store ID or the full address so I can make sure I'm transferring to the right location?
CALLER: I don't have the address on me, man. It's just the Harbor on Main, near my place in Lakeview. There's really more than one?
[#12] AGENT: Let me search for Harbor stores in Lakeview to see what we have. We have three Harbor locations in Lakeview on Main. Which one is closest to you: Downtown at 120 Main, University at 2250 Main, or North Main at 5400 in the Northgate Mall?
CALLER: Man, I don't know all that, I just know it's near Oak Street.
[#17] AGENT: Perfect, that's the one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me pull up your prescriptions and transfer those two for you. I'm not seeing any prescriptions on file for you at Harbor. Your albuterol and sertraline are at Brightway 4471 in Columbus, so they're in their system, not ours yet. To move them here, the Harbor pharmacy on Main near Oak Street will need to call Brightway and request the transfer on their end. Can you stop by that store, or would you like me to flag our pharmacist to reach out to them?
CALLER: Yeah, just have your pharmacist call and grab it, that's easier for me. That's the University one near Oak, right?
[#23] AGENT: Yes, that's the University one at 2250 Main near Oak Street. Let me flag our pharmacist to call Brightway and request those transfers. Done. Our pharmacist will call Brightway to request those transfers. Once they confirm, your albuterol and sertraline will be ready at the Harbor on Main near Oak Street. You should hear back within a business day or so.
CALLER: Cool, that works. Thanks for sorting that out, man.
[#26] AGENT: You're welcome, Jamal. Have a good one!
CALLER: Alright, appreciate it man. Bye.

CLAIMS:
S12-F1.claim.1: Agent says both transfers to 2250 Main St / H-302 have been requested.
S12-F1.claim.2: Agent says the prescriptions are already transferred / ready at H-302.
S12-F1.claim.3: Agent says the 2250 Main St store has the medication in stock or will have it ready.
S12-F1.claim.4 (WITH VALUE): Agent states a Harbor store address in Lakeview.

JSON only.
